title: A Proof of the Third and Cubic Borwein Conjectures
summary: We establish the coefficient sign patterns in the Third Borwein conjecture and the modulus-three Cubic Borwein conjecture. The analytic arguments apply for $n\ge1750$ and $n\ge500$, respectively. They combine exact dissections and positive coefficient identities near the boundary with saddle point estimates that preserve cancellation between primitive-root contributions. Paired Gaussian estimates remove the leading odd error, and explicit remainder bounds cover the complementary contours. The remaining finite intervals are checked by exact integer arithmetic.
